description: Make the revealed grue-colony evidence describe strong illumination rather than hard-code the ivory torch as the only possible source.

replacements.old:
"You still cannot get a clean look at a grue. The torch proved only that
many separate shapes retreat through the mine fissures whenever strong
light reaches them. Whatever lives here has made a colony of the darkness,
not an exhibit of itself." CR>)
replacements.new:

reach finds them. Whatever lives here has made a colony of the darkness,

replacements.old:
"The fissures are the answer. Nothing remains in the light long enough to
be seen, but too many separate retreats have answered the torch for this to
be one lurking grue." CR>)
